title: Bella Beaver's Shiny Pebble
description: Bella finds a perfectly smooth river pebble, but learns that sharing it brings a far greater shine to her day.

scenes.narration: Deep in the green forest stream, Bella Beaver found the smoothest, shiniest pebble she had ever seen. It sparkled under the water like a tiny treasure.
scenes.visual: A small brown beaver holding a shiny wet pebble beside a clear forest stream

scenes.narration: Bella wanted to keep the pebble inside her cozy lodge. But as she splashed along the bank, she saw a little duckling sitting beside a messy twig nest.
scenes.visual: A fluffy yellow duckling sitting beside a messy twig nest near quiet water

scenes.narration: The morning wind kept blowing the duckling's nest away. The little bird looked tired and sad, trying to keep the twigs together.
scenes.visual: Wind blowing dry leaves around a small nest made of grass and twigs

scenes.narration: Bella looked at her shiny pebble, then at the floating nest. She knew the heavy stone would keep the duckling's home warm and safe.
scenes.visual: A little beaver gazing thoughtfully at a smooth stone sitting in her paws

scenes.narration: With a kind smile, Bella placed her smooth pebble right in the center of the nest. The twigs stayed perfectly still against the gentle breeze.
scenes.visual: A beaver gently placing a smooth pebble on the edge of a duckling nest

scenes.narration: The duckling let out a happy quack and cuddled into the safe nest. Bella realized that helping a friend felt even better than keeping a shiny pebble.
scenes.visual: A beaver and a duckling sitting together happily on sunny riverbank grass

scenes.narration: When you share love, every day shines a little brighter. Follow along for more sweet bedtime stories every single night.
scenes.visual: A tranquil forest stream with soft sunlight filtering through green tree leaves

character_reference: A plump chestnut-brown beaver with a light cream belly, large glossy black eyes, and a broad, flat paddle-like tail. She features prominent white front teeth and short, rounded brown ears.
